title: Space Coast Zine Club Meetup at Creative Playground
description: Join Space Coast Zine Club for its first-ever meetup at The Creative Playground. Make your own mini zine, cut, paste, doodle, collage, meet other local creatives, and explore the creative space. Admission is free and basic supplies are provided; feel free to bring favorite pens, magazines, stickers, scissors, or other crafty materials. Come alone, bring a friend, or just bring an idea.
